title: Hamburg MapTask Corpus (HAMATAC)
manual_evidence: Repository metadata explicitly identifies transcription as manual orthographic/simplified HIAT, disfluency as manual annotation, and pho as manual annotation of phonetic phenomena; automatic POS/lemma layers are excluded.
lineage_notes: Primary L2 German map-task recordings; current v1.0.0 is a later release of the same HAMATAC recording lineage, so versions must not be counted as independent recordings.
